subject: TASK-310
summary: TASK-310 received 3 changes-requested events; inspect for a reusable prevention lesson.
resolution_reason: TASK-310's repeated rework is real but already represented by existing lessons: INS-0058 covers submission/review evidence freshness and cross-checking the actual source under review, and INS-0059 covers privileged authority/gateway changes needing adversarial review beyond functional review.
